page.layout: One printed page, title page within a decorative woodcut border; all text centred in one block, no margins or notes.
page.notes: Woodcut border and a floral woodcut ornament between "Amor meus crucifixus est." and the imprint are not transcribed. Date line "clɔ Iɔ xvc." is the old-form numeral for MDXV (printed 1595; read as printed). Handwritten marks in the upper right corner are excluded. The imprint line is set in a mixed roman and italic style; italic words are not marked since the title page is set as a list of lines.
